Class QualificationLevelService

java.lang.Object
de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.service.skill.QualificationLevelService
@Service @Transactional public class QualificationLevelService extends Object
The qualification levels of the installation and what an hour of each is costed at.

Every method is permission-checked, reads included. A level's cost rate is the basis of every labour figure the platform reports, and publishing it to anyone who can log in would hand out the wage structure of the business — see QualificationLevel for why the rate hangs on the level in the first place.

Author:
peter haller

    • createQualificationLevel

      public QualificationLevel createQualificationLevel(QualificationLevel level, PUser user)
      Creates a level. The name is mandatory and unique regardless of case — two levels called "Geselle" and "geselle" would split the same people into two groups and quietly halve every figure reported for either.

    • updateQualificationLevel

      public QualificationLevel updateQualificationLevel(Long levelId, QualificationLevel update, PUser user)
      Replaces a level's data. This is a PUT: the request is the new state, so cost fields left out clear the rate. That is the only way to stop costing a level — there is no patch semantics here in which null could mean "unchanged".

    • deleteQualificationLevel

      public void deleteQualificationLevel(Long levelId, PUser user)
      Deletes a level, but only while nobody is assigned to it. Detaching people automatically would silently drop the qualification of everyone who held it, and the loss would only show up later as unpriced hours in a cost report — by which time nobody remembers what those people were.

    • assignQualificationLevel

      public PUser assignQualificationLevel(Long userId, Long levelId, PUser currentUser)
      Puts a user on a qualification level, or takes them off it when levelId is null.

      Deliberately its own endpoint rather than a field on the user update: the assignment is what decides how that person's hours are costed, and it is guarded by UPDATE on the level, not by whoever happens to be allowed to edit a user's phone number.
